verdict.rationale: The only browser-related docs describe running the browser outside the devbox on Browserbase or Kernel, explicitly with "no Chromium ever runs in the devbox." That is an external-service integration, not a headless browser or desktop inside the sandbox. Custom Dockerfile blueprints are only a building block a developer could use to install one, and there is no documented desktop or VNC environment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a headless browser or full desktop environment inside the sandbox
